summary: Barclays PLC furnished a Form 6-K containing its interim results announcement for the three months ended March 31, 2026. The filing includes unaudited financial statements, share capital information, and reconciliations of non-IFRS measures. It does not announce any M&A, restructuring, tender offer, or other special-situation corporate event. The filing is a routine quarterly earnings report by a foreign private issuer, governed by SEC rules, and does not trigger any special-situation classification.
